'''DeckTech tournament reports''' are the trip reports DeckTech published alongside its decklists. Stephen Skilton's archive keeps them under [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/tournament_reports/ tournament_reports] with per-report URLs such as [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-11-sokols-dcon-2000-reportd1327/ sokols-dcon-2000-report]. Live [http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/tournament-reports/ decktech.net/starwarsccg/tournament-reports] is a later shell that does not list those posts in static HTML. The index runs from August 1999 local events through later Worlds reports.

Reports name who played, finishes, pairings, and sometimes a 60. Dest copies on this wiki fill [[List of SWCCG tournaments]] hubs and player Tournament Results. The archive is the historical copy; this wiki is the reading copy.
